summary: Authored a five-phase implementation plan for the sapience project-binding and vault-read foundation: the shared scripts/lib/sapience-api-lib.sh (host/token precedence, authenticated POST/GET, token redaction, bounded cold-start retry), then sapience-project-bind.sh and sapience-vault-read.sh in parallel, then their two new test suites, then the lockstep/manifest registration and full verification. Re-validated every carried figure from the dispatch against live sources and ran suite_selection_select over all five planned paths so each Tier Justification names a measured result. Surfaced two mechanically required files the dispatch FILE SCOPE omitted: the extension manifest's provides.scripts array and test-sapience-mcp-registration.sh's hardcoded LOCKSTEP_FILES list.

artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan, 8 estimated hours, 4 dependency waves, validated clean by validate-artifact.sh.
